concerns.text: Power analysis (FR‑009, FR‑011) is only described for the TOST equivalence test between Full‑Parameter OPD and Frozen‑Subspace OPD. The plan does not include a pre‑study power analysis for the paired t‑tests used in the SFT comparisons (US‑2), which may leave those tests under‑powered.

The plan assumes the entire experimental matrix (30 seeds × 5 conditions ≈ 150 runs) will complete within the 6‑hour CI wall‑clock limit. No justification or feasibility analysis is provided; this may be unrealistic on a CPU‑only runner and could cause systematic early termination, biasing results.
